title: Keep approval admission independent of tenant credential lookup
summary: Host authentication metadata and approval redaction need bounded system paths while scoped secret access continues to fail closed.
reusable_steps: Host authentication metadata and approval redaction need bounded system paths while scoped secret access continues to fail closed
expected_outcome: Read pre-admission host token metadata only through the existing exact-file registry role and a trusted explicit system tenant clear. Restore the outer tenant and reject conflicting resource or envelope constraints; never widen access to other personal connections. Approval presentation must use the host-only redactor so an unbound tenant can request human authorization without resolving credentials; verify both continued secret lookup denial and known-value masking. Skip provider bootstrap only for audited deterministic log/transform operations; unknown and reasoning operations remain conservative. Keep tenant SDK retries disabled and honor no-redispatch at send time while retaining ordinary operator behavior. Preserve explicit model/profile routing when restoring an inherited native path. Make CI fixtures canonical on case-sensitive filesystems, isolate provider health, validate credentials before binary discovery, and test denied plugin target absence rather than harmless empty lock parents. Validate module direction with pure primitives below orchestration rather than increasing allowances. Combine a broad core run with sequential strict affected suites and inspect remote CI; a non-strict run with live-state warnings is not strict-clean. This record was curated from source, test evidence and an independent non-contributor review; structural extraction itself performed no LLM review.
